spellbook.finance/limitations: Targets come only from retained source previous cents. This preparation submits no price and never chooses a correction or changes automation.
An expired source execution grant does not erase retained receipt evidence. The new compensation needs its own valid owner approval and expiry.
Current controls, account identity, membership, continuity and fresh provider ask still apply. Restoration reverses no quantity, sale or order and cannot guarantee remote atomic compare-and-set.

description: Prepare a new exact eBay pricing approval from selected accepted source receipts. Returns eligible listing identities, typed conflicts and missing evidence. First read the source with spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_get. The owner must choose manual automation and approve the new compensation in the web app; read its approval before spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_execute.

listingIds.description: Owner-selected canonical eBay listing IDs from the source operation. Required; duplicates are refused.

sourceOperationId.description: Source exact pricing operation ID containing retained accepted receipts. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_pricing_restoration_prepare
